title: Cobblemon Effect Descriptions
description: Resource pack adding JEED / EMIffect support for some Cobblemon addons
body:
Simple small resource pack adding [JEED (Just Enough Effect Descriptions)](https://modrinth.com/mod/just-enough-effect-descriptions-jeed) and [EMIffect](https://modrinth.com/mod/emiffect) support for some Cobblemon addons, with more to potentially come later. Achieved by using JEED's formatting for adding lang translations. 

Only supports en_us!

Currently supports:
- [CobbleCuisine](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblecuisine)
- [Legendary Monuments](https://modrinth.com/mod/legendary-monuments)

Icons in the logo belong to Just Enough Effect Descriptions (JEED) and EMIffect, I do not own them and have only used them for showing this pack is meant for use with either of them.
